<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Projectile Motion Simulator</title>
    <style>
        body, html {
            margin: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: #000;
        }
        /* Hide inputs (extracted by parent shell) */
        input {
            position: absolute;
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
<!-- HTML Inputs for adjustable variables -->
<input type="range" id="launchAngle" min="0" max="90" value="45">
<input type="range" id="launchVelocity" min="10" max="100" value="50">
<input type="checkbox" id="gravityToggle" checked>

<!-- Full Screen Canvas -->
<canvas id="simulationCanvas"></canvas>

<script>
    // **Model (State & Logic)**
    const MODEL = {
        width: window.innerWidth,
        height: window.innerHeight,
        gravity: 9.81, // m/s²
        projectile: {
            x: 0,
            y: 0,
            vx: 0,
            vy: 0,
            radius: 0.2, // meters
            launched: false
        },
        target: {
            x: window.innerWidth * 0.8,
            y: window.innerHeight * 0.2,
            radius: 50 // pixels (not meters, for display)
        },
        game: {
            score: 0,
            attempts: 0,
            health: 100,
            power: 50
        },
        get launchAngle() { return parseFloat(document.getElementById('launchAngle').value); },
        get launchVelocity() { return parseFloat(document.getElementById('launchVelocity').value); },
        get gravityEnabled() { return document.getElementById('gravityToggle').checked; }
    };

    // **Transform Function (Model to View)**
    const modelToView = (modelValue, isY = false) => {
        if (isY) return MODEL.height - (modelValue * MODEL.height / 10); // Adjust for positive Y upwards
        return modelValue * MODEL.width / 10; // Simplified scaling for demo
    };

    // **View (Rendering)**
    const canvas = document.getElementById('simulationCanvas');
    canvas.width = MODEL.width;
    canvas.height = MODEL.height;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

    const drawSky = () => {
        const skyGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, MODEL.height);
        skyGradient.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB'); // Sky Blue
        skyGradient.addColorStop(1, '#4682B4'); // Deep Sky Blue
        ctx.fillStyle = skyGradient;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, MODEL.width, MODEL.height);
    };

    const drawClouds = () => {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(MODEL.width * 0.2, MODEL.height * 0.1, 50, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fill();
        // Add more clouds as desired...
    };

    const drawTerrain = () => {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#8B9467'; // Grass/Dirt
        ctx.fillRect(0, MODEL.height * 0.9, MODEL.width, MODEL.height * 0.1);
    };

    const drawProjectile = () => {
        if (MODEL.projectile.launched) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#FF0000'; // Red
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(modelToView(MODEL.projectile.x), modelToView(MODEL.projectile.y, true), modelToView(MODEL.projectile.radius), 0, 2 * Math.PI);
            ctx.fill();
        } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#00FF00'; // Green (pre-launch)
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(modelToView(0), modelToView(MODEL.height * 0.9 - MODEL.projectile.radius, true), modelToView(MODEL.projectile.radius), 0, 2 * Math.PI);
            ctx.fill();
        }
    };

    const drawTarget = () => {
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#00FF00'; // Green
        ctx.lineWidth = 5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(MODEL.target.x, MODEL.target.y, MODEL.target.radius, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.stroke();
    };

    const drawHUD = () => {
        ctx.font = '24px Arial';
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
        ctx.fillText(`Score: ${MODEL.game.score}`, 10, 10);
        ctx.fillText(`Attempts: ${MODEL.game.attempts}`, 10, 40);
        
        ctx.font = '36px Arial';
        ctx.textAlign = 'right';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'bottom';
        ctx.fillText(`${MODEL.game.health}%`, MODEL.width - 10, MODEL.height - 10);
        ctx.fillText(`${MODEL.game.power}%`, MODEL.width - 10, MODEL.height - 50);
    };

    const drawWinState = () => {
        ctx.font = '64px Arial';
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.fillText("LEVEL CLEARED!", MODEL.width / 2, MODEL.height / 2);
        // Confetti implementation omitted for brevity
    };

    const updateModel = (dt) => {
        if (MODEL.projectile.launched) {
            MODEL.projectile.x += MODEL.projectile.vx * dt;
            MODEL.projectile.y += MODEL.projectile.vy * dt + (MODEL.gravityEnabled ? 0.5 * MODEL.gravity * dt**2 : 0);
            MODEL.projectile.vy += MODEL.gravityEnabled ? MODEL.gravity * dt : 0; // Apply gravity

            // Collision with terrain
            if (modelToView(MODEL.projectile.y, true) > MODEL.height * 0.9) {
                MODEL.projectile.launched = false;
                MODEL.game.attempts++;
            }

            // Check target hit
            const distanceToTarget = Math.hypot(MODEL.projectile.x - MODEL.target.x / MODEL.width * 10, MODEL.projectile.y - MODEL.target.y / MODEL.height * 10);
            if (distanceToTarget < MODEL.projectile.radius + MODEL.target.radius / MODEL.width * 10) {
                MODEL.game.score++;
                drawWinState();
                setTimeout(() => {
                    MODEL.projectile.launched = false;
                }, 2000); // Wait for win state display
            }
        }
    };

    const render = () => {
        drawSky();
        drawClouds();
        drawTerrain();
        drawProjectile();
        drawTarget();
        drawHUD();
        
        if (MODEL.projectile.launched && !MODEL.game.health <= 0) {
            requestAnimationFrame(render);
            const dt = 0.016; // Approximate 60 FPS
            updateModel(dt);
        }
    };

    // **Event Listeners & API**
    window.simAPI = {
        reset: () => {
            MODEL.projectile = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, radius: 0.2, launched: false };
            MODEL.game = { score: 0, attempts: 0, health: 100, power: 50 };
            render(); // Redraw after reset
        },
        play: () => {
            if (!MODEL.projectile.launched) {
                const angleRad = MODEL.launchAngle * Math.PI / 180;
                MODEL.projectile.vx = MODEL.launchVelocity * Math.cos(angleRad);
                MODEL.projectile.vy = MODEL.launchVelocity * Math.sin(angleRad);
                MODEL.projectile.launched = true;
                render();
            }
        },
        pause: () => {
            // Pause logic (currently no continuous update without launch)
        }
    };

    // Drag to Launch Mechanics (Simplified for Demo)
    let dragStartX, dragStartY, isDragging = false;
    canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        dragStartX = e.clientX - rect.left;
        dragStartY = e.clientY - rect.top;
        isDragging = true;
    });
    canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
        if (isDragging) {
            const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
            const currentX = e.clientX - rect.left;
            const currentY = e.clientY - rect.top;
            // Simplified drag logic: Update launch angle/velocity based on drag direction and distance
            const dx = currentX - dragStartX;
            const dy = currentY - dragStartY;
            document.getElementById('launchAngle').value = Math.min(Math.max(45 + (dy / 10), 0), 90); // Adjust angle
            document.getElementById('launchVelocity').value = Math.min(Math.max(50 + (Math.hypot(dx, dy) / 5), 10), 100); // Adjust velocity
        }
    });
    canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
        isDragging = false;
        window.simAPI.play(); // Launch on drag release
    });

    // Input Event Listeners
    document.getElementById('launchAngle').addEventListener('input', window.simAPI.reset);
    document.getElementById('launchVelocity').addEventListener('input', window.simAPI.reset);
    document.getElementById('gravityToggle').addEventListener('change', window.simAPI.reset);

    // Initial Render
    render();
</script>
</body>
</html>
